Taobao open stays 50301 until B1-06f; production wiring (app.module) is B1-06w. Downgraded by the orchestrator (approvals 18): Codex round 2 S1 on reusing a single-flight conversion across the cache expiry instant (expire_at at most 3 s in the past, no change to identity or amounts) -> fixed in B1-06m. Written by hand.
